title: MCP tools: add more live server compatibility tests
summary: The MCP tools surface is still experimental. Add a small, repeatable set of live compatibility fixtures/tests against common server behaviors (id encoding, stderr noise, delayed flush, large payloads) so regressions are caught before expanding protocol claims.
expectedFailureModes: A server that emits numeric ids as strings causes requests to hang or misroute.
Non-protocol stderr output breaks parsing or blocks responses in the CLI boundary.
Large tool payloads regress framing or buffering and fail only in production.
nextAction: Add 2-3 targeted covenant-mcp live/fixture tests that exercise real-world server response edge cases (start with string/numeric ids and mixed stdout/stderr), and wire them into validate.sh.
